name: Elise Triad
source:
An engineering support specialist and a top-secret military android prototype EL-03, Elise is undergoing on-site testing on a remote moon base. Her true identity and nature is known only by [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Captain Osumi Leiji[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c14804]Commander Carla Benedict[/url]. To everybody else on the base, she's just an ordinary, low level technical staff member. Her skills will prove to be invaluable for Leiji's investigation. Despite her humanesque qualities, in the beginning Leiji will only see her as nothing but a mechanical doll.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
